title: "Hashem’s Contradiction" SCA Shabbat Message by Noah Levy
summary: This class discusses an apparent contradiction between the Makot and the teaching in Baba Metsia 59A regarding public shaming, resolving it through the Or Haim. It explores how the Makot were designed to strengthen the faith of Bene Israel and lead the Egyptians to recognize Hashem.
questions: How do the Makot fit with the teaching in Baba Metsia 59A about public shaming?
What does the Or Haim explain about the purpose of the Makot?
How were the Makot designed to affect Bene Israel and the Egyptians differently?
